item.title: “Not a big thing,” J&K captain Paras Dogra downplays headbutting Karnataka’s KV Aneesh in Ranji Trophy final
item.description: Jammu and Kashmir captain Paras Dogra broke silence on the on-field incident in which he head-butted Karnataka’s KV Aneesh during the second day's play in the Ranji Trophy final in Hubballi, saying that it wasn't a "big thing." item.title: “There will be 1000 opinions,” Faf du Plessis advises Abhishek Sharma to shut out outside noise amid T20 World Cup struggles
item.description: Heading into the T20 World Cup 2026, Abhishek Sharma was expected to be India's destroyer-in-chief. item.description: Sri Lanka's hopes of reaching the T20 World Cup 2026 semi-finals ended with a crushing 61-run defeat to New Zealand at the R Premadasa Stadium, Colombo on Wednesday (February 25).
